_meta: LANGUAGE: English. Mirror of es.json — never add a key here that doesn't exist there. Key order kept identical to make diffs readable.
_convencion: Flat dot-separated keys, NOT nested. Access is t['nav.home'], not t.nav.home.
site.title: StartupGo Global
site.description: Web design, internationalisation and content optimisation for companies growing across multiple languages.
_2_nav: ── Main navigation. Keep short: rendered inline. ──
_3_hero: ── Landing hero. hero.title is the <h1>: one per page, carries the main keyword. ──
hero.title: We grow your company's digital presence
hero.text: At StartupGo Global we help brands and businesses build clear, modern web experiences that are ready to scale across languages.
_4_services: ── The three service cards. Adding a fourth means replicating the .title/.text pair in BOTH files. ──
services.title: Services
services.design.title: Web design and layout
services.design.text: We build clear, accessible interfaces that adapt to any device.
services.i18n.title: Content internationalisation
services.i18n.text: We prepare websites to handle multiple languages in a structured way.
services.optimization.title: Content optimisation
services.optimization.text: We review structure, content quality and user experience.
contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Tell us what your company needs and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
_6_form: ── Form labels. Each label needs a for= matching its input id. ──
form.name: Full name
form.email.help: Enter a valid email, for example name@company.com
_7_formOptions: ── <option> values for the form.service select. The HTML value= stays in English; this is display text only. ──
_8_formState: ── Validation and submission feedback. Untranslated, these leak Spanish into the English site. ──
form.success: We've received your request. We'll be in touch shortly.
form.error: Couldn't send that. Please try again or email us directly.
_9_footer: ── {year} is substituted at render time — never hardcode it. ──
